title: Why You See Faces in the Moon and Clouds
hook: You can see faces everywhere, even in inanimate objects.

narration.text: You can see faces everywhere, even in inanimate objects.
Your brain is hardwired to detect faces, a survival mechanism.
It finds patterns in random shapes, like clouds or rock formations.
This tendency to see faces is called pareidolia.
Right now, look at the sky or a textured wall.
Do you notice any faces appearing in the patterns?
It is a natural part of how your brain processes visual information.
Try it right now, and tell us what faces you discovered.

description: Ever wondered why you sometimes see faces in everyday objects like the moon or clouds? It is a fascinating trick of your brain called pareidolia. Discover the surprising reason behind this common visual phenomenon and how your mind is wired to find patterns everywhere.
topic: Why you sometimes see a person's face in the moon or clouds. You can test this right now, look at the sky and see if you find faces.
